summary: Village page (modified 2026-07-14) still says an online system is coming and to book by phone at 403-364-3955; no rate or season on any village page. The closed Campspot listing (operator-written, undated) confirms 16 serviced 30 A + water sites, dump station, showers; its terms list C$32 power & water / C$22 tent, GST included - not written (undated, listing not bookable). Season left derived. Note unchanged.
flags: RATE (not written): the Campspot listing's terms read '30 Amp sites with power & water $32.00/night GST included', 'Monthly $800.00/unit/month', 'Tenting and non-serviced sites $22.00/night GST included', 'RV Overflow $22.00/night GST included', 'Maximum stay is 21 days unless monthly rate is being paid.', 'CHECK IN : 2:00 p.m.', 'CHECK OUT : PLEASE Before 11:59 a.m.' The listing is undated and books nothing (no sites for Jul 2027; earlier read showed it closed 2025-01-01 to 3000-01-06), so the rate has no 2024+ date. If accepted: nightly_low/high 32 CAD, tax included, max_stay_nights 21. No rate on the village's own pages.

OPERATOR: Campspot's legal name for the listing is 'Delia & District Agricultural Society, a Alberta Non-Profit Corporation, d/b/a Delia Community Campground' (email deliacampground@gmail.com; cancellation contact deliacamping@gmail.com / 403-618-6170). The Village of Delia's own site now carries the campground page and takes bookings ('Until then for bookings please call (403) 364-3955'). Ownership local kept; whether the ag society still runs it is unstated.
